title: Concept: Spreadsheet formula in an exported cell
description: An exported field that starts with a formula trigger in a response hands every reader the view the build or admin side kept: A spreadsheet evaluates the cell when an officer opens the export, which turns a customer-supplied name into code running on a back-office workstation.
applicability: Deployments that render an exported field that starts with a formula trigger into a customer- or partner-facing response.
risk: A spreadsheet evaluates the cell when an officer opens the export, which turns a customer-supplied name into code running on a back-office workstation.
